newsitem.title: USA: U.S. average retail beef prices lower in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S. average retail beef prices lower in February.

text.p: Average retail beef prices mostly eased in February from January but retail feature prices rose, the National Cattlemen's Beef Association said.

NCBA said that based on U.S. Agriculture Department data, the national average price of all fresh retail beef cuts in February was $2.55 a lb, down from $2.56 in January and $2.58 in February 1996. The price is based on 15 individual cuts and includes all grades of beef (choice, select and ungraded).
The USDA All Choice retail beef price average was $2.79 a lb in February, against $2.82 in January and $2.79 a year ago.
The average price of beef cuts featured in newspaper advertisements in February was $2.50 a lb, against $2.46 in January and $2.49 a year earlier, the NCBA said.
The featuring data derives from NCBA/CattleFax data.

The NCBA said aggressive featuring specials were evident in lower prices for ground beef, round roast and sirloin steak in February. But overall featured prices crept up influenced by the stronger tone of the fed cattle market, it said.

Beef prices are usually highest in the spring when supplies are the smallest, it added. Featured retail prices follow a seasonal pattern of falling prices into summer months more closely than everyday retail beef prices, NCBA said.

Beginning in January 1997, the NCBA changed its monthly analysis to include 15 cuts of beef from a previous six. For its featuring survey, it added special low advertised beef prices, prices for all grades of beef, and prices gathered throughout the month rather than once a month.
The featuring survey is divided into five geographic areas and includes all states except Alaska and Hawaii, compared to the previous 19-city monthly survey.

The averages of the five regions for the 15 cuts in February were: ground chuck $1.86 per lb, regular ground beef $1.40, lean ground beef $2.07; select boneless chuck roast $2.17; choice boneless chuck roast $2.44, choice boneless round roast $2.91, select round roast $2.65, choice rib roast $5.12, choice T-bone steak $5.88, choice rib-eye steak $5.53, choice boneless round steak $3.14, select round steak $2.98, select sirloin steak $3.59, choice boneless sirloin steak $4.03, and boneless beef for stew $2.50.
